text: Chinese-Language learner program (above half a year): The School of International Cultural Exchange of Beijing International Studies University is mainly responsible for the carrying out of Chinese courses teaching. It specializes in enrolling and teaching foreign students. The School of International Cultural Exchange of Beijing International Studies University provides the specialty of Chinese (including tourism route and finance route) for undergraduate program and also Chinese-Language learner program. The School of International Cultural Exchange of Beijing International Studies University is among the first batch of organizations that are authorized to hold the HSK Exam in Beijing. The HSK Exam is held three times annually in May, July and December. Basic Courses: Extensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Listening Comprehension, Dialogue, Newspaper Reading and Film Appreciation etc. Application Deadline for spring semester is December 31
